## How it works

<h2>Developer integration</h2><p>Use <code>viewer.setMessage(textOrNull, options?)</code> for project notices. Pass a string to show a message or <code>null</code> to dismiss it. These are message previews; no project data is saved or imported by this page.</p><p>Copy this folder and serve it over HTTP, for example <code>python -m http.server 8080</code>. Open <code>http://localhost:8080/</code>; the SDK and sample downloads require internet access.</p>
